journey.name: Starter: sigil-less launch
journey.description:
A fresh install of the quickstart app must render its screen and stay usable before any sigil exists. This is the first thing anyone following the docs runs, so a regression here is the worst possible first impression.
Also pins the SessionLock trap fixed in this SDK: a sigil-less session used to lock itself on a screen whose only control called ensureSeedReady, which throws SigilRequiredException every time when there is no sigil, so every retry failed identically and force-stopping was the only way out.

actions.action: Verify the screen does NOT show "LOCKED"
Verify the screen does NOT show "Authentication didn't complete"
Verify the screen does NOT show "Something went wrong"
